_note: One record per file under marks/. Authored, never generated: lint-mark-provenance.ts compares it with the folder listing in both directions, and lint-mark-colors.ts compares each record's colors with the fills it re-parses from the file.

Owner decision on #2343, Q-B1 B (2026-10-26): every mark the owner supplies is committed, because the repository is for internal use for now. IF THE REPOSITORY GOES PUBLIC, refactor to the Q-B1 A model before it does: commit a mark only when its source terms permit this use, recorded here, and keep a same-name neutral placeholder for every other mark (the artwork stays in the Figma library and in the client code).

Every record is the owner's artwork (#2343 PR 3, 2026-10-27), assembled from several public sources and hand-edited; the original sources and their terms are not recorded, so each record says so and names the provider as rights holder. payment/generic is the owner's own card and names no provider.

Payment tiles are full-bleed (owner decision Q720 A, 2026-10-26): square corners, no border, the tile's ground kept. The brand-mark component draws each tile's corner radius and its edge from tokens, so a tile file never bakes either. lint-mark-colors.ts checks the edge is bound on every payment member; lint-glyph-geometry.ts checks no tile file bakes a corner or a border. A record with fullBleed: false (payment/generic, a silhouette with no ground) skips only the ground check.
A record's normalized list states each change made so the file passes emit-marks.ts, and why. No step changes a color: a keyword is written as its hex. A logo's width is its artwork's (Q781 A).
